title: Plastics and Synthetic Materials
summary: Nylon, polyester, PVC, bakelite: what polymers are, thermoplastics vs thermosetting plastics, and the plastic pollution problem.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Class 8 Ch 3: Synthetic Fibres and Plastics (not in Curiosity Class 8)

objectives: I can explain that plastics and synthetic fibres are polymers made of long chains of repeating units.
I can distinguish thermoplastics from thermosetting plastics and give uses of each.
I can compare biodegradable and non-biodegradable materials.
I can evaluate ways to reduce plastic pollution (the 5 Rs).
misconceptions: All plastics can be melted and remoulded.
Biodegradable means it disappears in a few days anywhere.
Recycling alone can solve plastic pollution.
